text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! I need to adjust my speed 
here...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, h-huh? A dream... an illusion?? 
Oh, no. This is what happens after 
watching race videos all night long...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll wash my face with cold water 
one more time. I have to make sure not to 
worry Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Narita Top Road wasn't able to 
rest very well...
